name: Ring Chromosome 4 Syndrome

criteria.description: Detection of ring chromosome 4 by karyotype or molecular cytogenetic analysis
Characteristic craniofacial abnormalities including microcephaly and micrognathia
Developmental delay or intellectual disability of variable severity
Presence of limb malformations such as clinodactyly or syndactyly

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Cytogenetic confirmation of ring chromosome 4 plus at least one major clinical feature
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on cytogenetic analysis; clinical features vary widely depending on extent of chromosomal loss.

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests unless secondary complications present
imaging: Brain MRI may show microcephaly and structural abnormalities
Echocardiogram to evaluate congenital heart defects
genetic: Ring chromosome 4 detected by karyotype or FISH
Variable deletions of terminal 4p and 4q arms
other: Growth charts show failure to thrive

distinguishingFeatures: Deletion of 4p16.3 without ring chromosome formation
Different phenotypic spectrum depending on chromosome involved

redFlags: Congenital heart defects requiring early intervention
Feeding difficulties leading to failure to thrive
references: Rossi E, et al. Ring chromosome 4 syndrome: clinical and cytogenetic findings. Am J Med Genet. 2001.
